bagPolicy.summary: Moonrise Festival is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2023 edition (Aug. 12 to 13, 2023, Pimlico Race Course) and lists no newer dates. Last published rule (2023): small single-compartment bags and purses up to 12" x 12", and empty hydration packs with no more than two main compartments and one smaller one.

parking.note: The organizer has not published a current edition's parking plan. For any future event, use the official Moonrise travel information rather than historical third-party directions.

rideshare.note: Whether you’re ridesharing (Uber/Lyft), taking a taxi, or getting picked up/dropped off by a friend, all guest pick-up/drop-offs must go to the designated Rideshare area, located just a short walk away from the festival entrance.

concessions.note: Food and beverage offerings are event-specific. The organizer has not posted a current edition's vendor list; use official festival guidance if a new event is announced.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: In continually trying to make our event more accessible, we encourage you to contact us at ada@insomniac.com for any of your accessibility-related needs. reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Moonrise Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Moonrise Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Moonrise Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
